Unable to commit transaction (CommitRequestImpl{state=RECEIVED, numRetries=0, committable=KafkaCommittable{producerId=2, epoch=0, transactionalId='state-recovery-0-2', producer=null}}) because its producer is already fenced. This means that you either have a different producer with the same 'transactional.id' (this is unlikely with the 'KafkaSink' as all generated ids are unique and shouldn't be reused) or recovery took longer than 'transaction.timeout.ms' (7200000ms). In both cases this most likely signals data loss, please consult the Flink documentation for more details.
